sho-hud.title: Sho-Hud
sho-hud.description: Iranian-traditional-inspired psychedelic instrumental rock, microtonal fretless guitar riffs.
sho-hud.credits: Yahya Alkhansa — percussion · Kate Pass — electric bass

all-you-could-have-been.title: All You Could Have Been
all-you-could-have-been.description: The album’s only English-language track — rock, Setâr, double bass, drums, vocals.
all-you-could-have-been.credits: Yahya Alkhansa — drums · Kate Pass — double bass · Mani — Setâr, vocals

12.description: 12 recounts the mourning of my heart during Israel's 12-day invasion of my homeland in June 2025 as I visited my friends and family back home. The song begins with bewilderment and gradually transitions into solace and resolve. On the eve of the 11th day, I opened the Divan of Hafez, pleading to the mystic poet to guide me. He spoke to me resolutely from the Great Beyond.

Shiraz Pamir.title: Shiraz Pamir
Shiraz Pamir.description: “Shiraz – Pamir” is a contemporary adaptation of a beautiful traditional Central Asian devotional tune by The Badakhshân Ensemble, with sublime poetry from 14th century mystic Persian poet, Hâfez of Shiraz.

daybreak.title: Daybreak
daybreak.description: An homage to the historically intertwined world of Iranian classical music and poetry, Daybreak's sound borrows heavily from Iranian folk melodies and lyrical sensibilities while developing a contemporary psychedelic sound.

For Unidentified Body 11780.title: For Unidentified Body 11780
For Unidentified Body 11780.description: An improvised space of mourning, dedicated to an unnamed slain protester during the massacre of Iranian protesters, January 2026.
